D003_l001.question:
A 44-year-old married male employed as a construction site foreman presents with a 2-year and 2-month history of symptoms consistent with a neurodevelopmental disorder, with onset noted prior to 12 years of age. The patient reports persistent difficulties with motoric restlessness, manifesting as fidgeting and an internal sense of feeling restless. He describes frequent instances of leaving his seat in situations requiring prolonged sitting and experiences impulsivity characterized by blurting out answers prematurely and significant difficulty awaiting his turn in conversations or activities.

In addition to these hyperactive-impulsive manifestations, the patient reports notable inattentive symptoms. He struggles with sustaining attention during tasks and play activities, frequently fails to follow through on instructions, leading to incomplete work duties and chores, and experiences chronic difficulties with organization in various aspects of his life. These symptoms have resulted in functional impairment across occupational and personal domains.
D003_l001.options:
A. Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features
    B. Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Predominantly Hyperactive/Impulsive Presentation)
    C. Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Combined Presentation)
    D. Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Predominantly Inattentive Presentation)
